```{r,include=FALSE}
detachAllPackages <- function() {

  basic.packages <- c("package:stats","package:graphics","package:grDevices","package:utils","package:datasets","package:methods","package:base")

  package.list <- search()[ifelse(unlist(gregexpr("package:",search()))==1,TRUE,FALSE)]

  package.list <- setdiff(package.list,basic.packages)

  if (length(package.list)>0)  for (package in package.list) detach(package, character.only=TRUE)

}

detachAllPackages()
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(httr)
library(readr)

repo_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deanbaltiansky/left-behind/main/study-sep25/data/"

df_deid  <- readr::read_csv(paste0(repo_url,"df_raw_deid.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
df_lebe_gpt4o <- readr::read_csv(paste0(repo_url,"df_lebe_gpt4o.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
df_lebe_reasoncohesion <- readr::read_csv(paste0(repo_url,"df_lebe_reasoncohesion.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

```

remove ineligible participants

```{r}
#keep only those who finished
df_lebe <- df_deid %>% 
  filter(Finished == 1) %>% 
  filter(Progress == 100) %>% 
  filter(intro == 4)
```

Put NA's where necessary

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(income = ifelse(income == "Prefer not to answer",NA,income))
```

define income and edu as factors

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(income = factor(income,c("$0-$20,000",
                                  "$20,001-$40,000",
                                  "$40,001-$60,000",
                                  "$60,001-$80,000",
                                  "$80,001-$100,000",
                                  "$100,001-$120,000",
                                  "$120,001-$140,000",
                                  "$140,001-$160,000",
                                  "$160,001-$180,000",
                                  "$180,001-$200,000",
                                  "Over $200,000")),
         edu = factor(edu,c("noHS",
                            "GED",
                            "2yearColl",
                            "4yearColl",
                            "MA",
                            "PHD")),
         income_num = as.numeric(income),
         edu_num = as.numeric(edu))
```

fix race

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(race_1:race_8),function(x){as.character(x)}) %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(race_1:race_8),function(x){replace_na(x,"")}) %>% 
  mutate(race_num_1 = ifelse(race_1 != "",1,0),
         race_num_2 = ifelse(race_2 != "",1,0),
         race_num_3 = ifelse(race_3 != "",1,0),
         race_num_4 = ifelse(race_4 != "",1,0),
         race_num_5 = ifelse(race_5 != "",1,0),
         race_num_6 = ifelse(race_6 != "",1,0),
         race_num_7 = ifelse(race_7 != "",1,0),
         race_num_8 = ifelse(race_8 != "",1,0),
         race_num = race_num_1 + race_num_2 + race_num_3 + race_num_4 + race_num_5 + race_num_6 + race_num_7 + race_num_8,
         race = ifelse(race_num > 1,"multiracial",paste0(race_1,race_2,race_3,race_4,race_5,race_6,race_7,race_8)),
         race = ifelse(race == "",NA,race)) %>% 
  mutate(white_bin = ifelse(race == "White",1,0))
```

gender

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(man_bin = ifelse(gender == "man",1,0))
```

party 

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(rep_bin = ifelse(party_gen == "Republican",1,0),
         dem_bin = ifelse(party_gen == "Democrat",1,0),
         ind_bin = ifelse(party_gen == "Independent",1,0))
```

rename some vars

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  rename(ideo_con = ideo_1,
         ideo_lib = ideo_2,
         ideo_demsoc = ideo_3,
         ideo_lbrtn = ideo_4,
         ideo_prog = ideo_5,
         lebe_cont = lebe_cont_1)
         
         
```

reverse-score items

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(antiest_4R = 8 - antiest_4,
         system_R = 8 - system)
```

recode items

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(vote_2024 = ifelse(vote_2024 == "Other (please specify)",vote_2024_12_TEXT,vote_2024),
         party_followup = case_when(party_gen == "Democrat" ~ paste0("Democrat | ",party_dem),
                                    party_gen == "Republican" ~ paste0("Republican | ",party_rep),
                                    party_gen == "Independent" |
                                      party_gen == "No preference" |
                                      party_gen == "Other party" ~ paste0("Independent | ",party_ind),
                                    .default = NA)) 
```

mean scores

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(antidem = mean(c(antidem_1,
                          antidem_2,
                          antidem_3,
                          antidem_4,
                          antidem_5),na.rm = T),
         antiest = mean(c(antiest_1,
                          antiest_2,
                          antiest_3,
                          antiest_4R),na.rm = T),
         trust = mean(c(trust_con,
                        trust_gov,
                        trust_jud,
                        trust_sci,
                        trust_pol,
                        trust_news),na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

check

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(att_1 = ifelse(check_1 == "14285733",0,1),
         is_elg = ifelse(att_1 == 0,0,1))
```

clean text

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(describe = str_squish(describe))
```

attach from text analysis scripts

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  left_join(df_lebe_gpt4o %>% 
              rename(PID = id,
                     leftbehind_gpt = left_behind_score,
                     reasons = reasons_csv,
                     system_to_ind_gpt = systemic,
                     econ_to_cult_gpt = economic_or_cultural,
                     history_gpt = history,
                     trajectory_gpt = trajectory,
                     gov_gpt = government,),by = "PID") %>% 
  left_join(df_lebe_reasoncohesion,by = "PID")
```

removing mrl = 1

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  mutate(mrl = ifelse(mrl == 1,NA,mrl))
```

adding number of reasons

```{r}
n_reasons <- df_lebe %>% 
  select(PID,reasons) %>% 
  separate(reasons,into = c("reason_1","reason_2","reason_3","reason_4","reason_5","reason_6","reason_7","reason_8","reason_9","reason_10"),sep = ", ") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-PID,
               names_to = "reason_id",
               names_prefix = "reason_",
               values_to = "reason",
               values_drop_na = T) %>% 
  group_by(PID) %>% 
  summarise(n_reasons = max(reason_id)) %>% 
  ungroup()

df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  left_join(n_reasons,by = "PID")
```

```{r}
df_lebe <- df_lebe %>% 
  dplyr::select(PID,
                lebe_cont,

                elect_exp:elect_cult,

                antiest_1,
                          antiest_2,
                          antiest_3,
                          antiest_4R,
                trust_con,
                        trust_gov,
                        trust_jud,
                        trust_sci,
                        trust_pol,
                        trust_news,
                vote_2024,
                ideo_con:ideo_prog,
                party_gen,
```
